name: Africa
fact: Home to the Sahara, the largest hot desert in the world.

name: Antarctica
fact: It's so cold that almost no people live here — but lots of penguins do!

name: Asia
fact: This is the biggest continent — more than half of all the people in the world live here.

name: Australia
fact: This is the only continent that is also just one country.

name: Europe
fact: This continent packs more than 40 different countries close together.

name: North America
fact: This continent stretches all the way from icy Canada down to sunny Mexico.

name: South America
fact: Home to the Amazon rainforest, the largest rainforest on Earth.
